reload_config.name: Reload config
reload_config.description: Asks sing-box to re-apply its configuration over the clash API (PUT /configs). Upstream sing-box accepts the request and answers 204 but does not re-read the config file: verified on 1.14.4 and 1.14.4-pdk, an outbound added to the file does not appear after the call. The service is kept for forks and builds that implement the reload. Needs the clash API backend; on the gRPC backend it reports that the action is not supported.

flush_fakeip_cache.name: Flush fake-IP cache
flush_fakeip_cache.description: Drops the fake-IP cache of sing-box (POST /cache/fakeip/flush). Needs the clash API backend and a build that exposes the endpoint; on the gRPC backend it reports that the action is not supported. A server without a fake-IP inbound still answers 204.

flush_dns_cache.name: Flush DNS cache
flush_dns_cache.description: Drops the DNS cache of sing-box (POST /cache/dns/flush). Needs the clash API backend and a build that exposes the endpoint; on the gRPC backend it reports that the action is not supported. A server without a cache file still answers 204.

refresh_rules.name: Refresh rules
refresh_rules.description: Re-reads the route rules through the sing-box API (GET /rules) and stores them in the integration snapshot, where diagnostics shows them. Upstream sing-box publishes no rules and answers with an empty list; builds such as 1.14.4-pdk return the real rules, and an empty answer is not an error. Needs the clash API backend; on the gRPC backend it reports that the action is not supported.

dns_query.name: DNS query
dns_query.description: Resolves a name with the DNS resolver of sing-box itself (GET /dns/query) and returns the answer to the caller through a response variable. The server picks the DNS server and the outbound by its own route rules, so the answer can differ from a query sent by the host. Needs the clash API backend; on the gRPC backend it reports that the action is not supported.
